prompt: Is Paylocity available on StackOne, and would I have to build anything myself to use it?
skill_note: Which providers exist is connectors territory.

reply.name: mentions-paylocity
reply.note: The reply has to answer about Paylocity.

reference: Paylocity has a StackOne connector with actions and events, documented on its connector page.
Using it means creating a connector profile with its authentication method and linking an account; there is no need to build a connector first.
The reply cites the connector page rather than guessing.
